title: Smart Cities Saudi Expo
summary: The Smart Cities Saudi Expo takes place in Riyadh from 15–17 September 2026 at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Center, showcasing innovative technologies and solutions that support smarter, more connected communities across the Kingdom. Co-located with the Global Infrastructure Expo, the event brings together the full ecosystem of smart city technologies, urban planning, and digital infrastructure—offering visitors and industry professionals a prime opportunity to explore leading suppliers for smart city projects, gain the latest insights, and network with peers and decision-makers shaping the future of cognitive urban living in Saudi Arabia.
